scope: All 31 credited write-ups under the Kerala individual/group/teacher headings in the received SISF 2026 compendium. Not an inventory of all fair entrants, a Kerala Sasthrolsavam result, or a verified demonstration record.

review.method: All 49 content pages read in extracted text. All 31 title/school/credit blocks checked against rendered source images; 26 full method/result pages additionally checked visually. Actual section headings and page footers determine category/page ranges.
limitations: A compendium write-up records reported work, not independent performance or individual work division.
The contents table misplaces the Kerala teacher start at printed204; the actual first teacher write-up is printed192/PDF235.
No contacts, participant photographs or source-page images are copied into the repository.
Source spelling and address anomalies are preserved; the comma-bearing teacher credit is not split into invented people.

Three award correspondences are supported by visible source-photograph codes; the diaper correspondence remains a pupil/school/topic candidate. Original credit versions remain distinct; no prize or code is transferred into the standalone compendium fields.
